metadata.title: German B1 Verbs
metadata.scope: B1-only verb set; combine with a1_verbs.json and a2_verbs.json for cumulative A1-B1 practice.

cumulativeUse.duplicatePolicy: Dictionary forms already represented at A1 or A2 are excluded.

sources.name: Goethe-Zertifikat B1 Wortliste
sources.usage: Selection and principal parts only; official example sentences were not copied.

notes: The Goethe B1 vocabulary list is cumulative; this file contains only entries not already represented by the project A1 and A2 verb datasets.
Konjunktiv II defaults to the productive würde form; synthetic forms are null where they are not required for the application.
Optional reflexive uses are stored separately when the reference entry marks (sich).
A native-speaker editorial pass is recommended before production deployment.
